Story.title: Story
Story.description: A user's private writing session / story containing ordered manuscript sections.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the story owner.

defaultStyle.description: Default writing style selected for new recordings in this story.

defaultRefinedEnding.description: Default Burmese voice ending when Refined Flow is active.

defaultModel.description: Default Gemini model selected for this story.

sectionCount.description: Current number of sections belonging to this story (0..5000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was last updated.

Section.title: Section
Section.description: A single transcribed or uploaded voice section inside a story, with non-destructive style version history and Firebase Storage audio metadata.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the section owner.

order.description: Monotonic numeric ordering key (epoch ms) preserving chronological order across devices.

content.description: Active version prose text synchronized with versions[activeVersionIndex].text.

style.description: Writing style of the currently active version.

refinedEnding.description: Burmese voice ending of the currently active version.

model.description: Gemini model used for the currently active version.

mode.description: Processing mode used for this section.

versions.description: Bounded non-destructive version history array (1..50 items).

activeVersionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the currently active version inside versions.

audioUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL for the original audio clip (or empty string if unavailable).

storagePath.description: Firebase Storage object path users/{uid}/audio/{storyId}/{sectionId}.{ext} (or empty string).

audioId.description: Optional local fallback audio clip ID (or empty string).

audioMeta.description: Metadata describing the recorded or uploaded audio file (filename, mimeType, durationSec, sizeBytes).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the section was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the section was last modified.

/users/{userId}/stories/{storyId}.description: Private stories owned by the authenticated whitelisted user.

/users/{userId}/stories/{storyId}/sectio.description: Ordered manuscript sections and version histories belonging to a story.
